change: Enable exact mechanical-residual reuse after coupled-friction refresh in the ordinary shared-axis application. Only the changed wall law is refreshed at an unchanged accepted pose. A new Newton direction still requires the full current tangent.
defaultPolicy: createSharedAxisAppSystem enables reuse with coupledFrictionNewton unless explicitly overridden; simulator standard shared-axis enables it, with frictionAssembly=0 as opt-out. Browser crossover uses the same setting.

confirmation.note: Initial measurement predates application default activation; the advanceSharedAxis kernel and explicit before/after options were the same. Confirmation includes current source hashes and assembly counters.

validation.fixtureRepair: Two friction assembly replay tests now load the archived open anatomy. Its mesh identity exactly matches both saved discovery certificates; current anatomy mismatched them. No tolerances or assertions were weakened.
